newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps - Regrade firms on jet trades.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps - Regrade firms on jet trades.

text.p: Singapore jet fuel/gas oil spread (regrade) widened late afternoon on Thursday following recent purchases of physical jet fuel cargoes, traders said.
"There's some strength in the jet market because of all the recent physical buying," one broker said.
May regrade was last quoted at minus 50/30 cents from Wednesday's minus 55/40 cents while June rose to plus 65/75 cents from 55/65 cents on Wednesday, brokers said.
Over the past week, local traders have bought about one million barrels of jet fuel with two 100,000-barrel cargoes traded on Wednesday at $25.50 and $24.60 per barrel on a free-on-board basis.
Traders said the purchases by the local traders which are now totalling almost three million barrels since March 3 has given the market a much needed boost in a period of low demand.
Gas oil extended its early day lacklustre trade with no trades confirmed.
May gas oil swaps were last quoted steady from Wednesday at $25.35/$25.55 per barrel, with June up 15 cents at $24.30/$24.50, brokers said.
Traders said the market was very quiet with June edging up on the belief by some that the buying spree of the local traders might be extended to at least end April.
The local traders have since March 3 bought well over 15 million barrels of physical gas oil for lifting from end March to late May.
The traders on Wednesday bought two 150,000-barrel cargoes at between $26.50 to $27.00 for May loading.
The fuel oil swaps steady with May last quoted at $97.50/$98.50 per tonne.
